title: Final Integration - Ship Launch
description: The ultimate challenge: Build a complete ship diagnostic system integrating ALL Robot Framework fundamentals to escape planet Syntax-IV.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "This is it, PROTO-7. The storms are reaching critical levels. We have ONE chance to launch. Build the complete ship diagnostic system—check all 47 critical components, validate every system, and if all tests pass... we escape. This is everything you've learned."
story.context: The final challenge integrates every concept from the entire fundamentals course: syntax, variables, assertions, control flow, templates, libraries, custom keywords, error handling. This is production-grade automation.
story.arc: Build a complete diagnostic suite with all 4 sections (Settings, Variables, Test Cases, Keywords), validate all ship systems, handle errors gracefully, and generate launch readiness report.
